data.name: モーキス
data.detailed_description:
"At the end of the century, somehow, I fell in love with you."

Set in a high school in Kokubunji, Tokyo, in 1999, Mokis is a romance visual novel about youth, love, and the approaching end of the world. As Nostradamus' prophecy begins to feel frighteningly real, you spend your school days building relationships with six unique heroines, each carrying her own hopes, fears, and personal struggles.

Against the backdrop of a collapsing world, your choices shape the story and reveal different sides of each heroine. As the end draws near, what will people seek most? What dreams do these girls pursue before everything changes? Beneath the June sun, it is time for someone to grow up.

data.short_description: June, 1999. In a Tokyo suburb overshadowed by Nostradamus' prophecy, grow closer to six girls as the end of the world approaches. An emotional romance visual novel where your choices shape each heroine's fate and reveal what people truly seek at the end of an era.
